tasks.title: Setup Project Repository and Initialize Node.js
tasks.description: Create a new project directory, initialize a Git repository, and set up Node.js with npm.
tasks.details: Create a new folder for the project. Run `git init` to initialize version control. Use `npm init -y` to generate a package.json file. Add a .gitignore file (node_modules, .env, etc.). Ensure Node.js (v20.x LTS recommended) is installed.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify repository is initialized, package.json exists, and .gitignore is correctly configured.

tasks.title: Install and Configure Express Framework
tasks.description: Install Express and set up a basic server entry point.
tasks.details: Run `npm install express@4.19.2` (latest stable). Create an entry file (app.js or server.js). Set up Express to parse JSON requests using `express.json()`. Configure the server to listen on a port from environment variables, defaulting to 3000.
tasks.testStrategy: Start the server and verify it responds to a basic GET request at '/' with a 200 status.

tasks.title: Implement RESTful API Endpoints
tasks.description: Define RESTful endpoints for research-backed task generation and API integration patterns.
tasks.details: Create endpoints such as POST /tasks (generate task), GET /tasks (list tasks), and GET /health (health check). Use Express Router for modularity. Follow REST conventions and ensure endpoints are stateless.
tasks.testStrategy: Use Postman or similar tool to send requests to each endpoint and verify correct responses and status codes.

tasks.title: Integrate Multiple Data Sources
tasks.description: Add support for fetching and aggregating data from multiple research sources (e.g., APIs, mock databases).
tasks.details: Implement async functions to fetch data from at least two sources (e.g., a public API and a local JSON file). Use Axios (v1.7.2) for HTTP requests. Structure data aggregation logic for extensibility.
tasks.testStrategy: Mock external APIs and verify data is correctly fetched, merged, and returned by the endpoints.

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Error Handling
tasks.description: Add robust error handling middleware and input validation.
tasks.details: Use Express error-handling middleware. Validate incoming requests with Joi (v17.10.0) or Zod (v3.22.4). Ensure all endpoints return meaningful error messages and appropriate HTTP status codes.
tasks.testStrategy: Send invalid and malformed requests to endpoints and verify correct error responses and status codes.

tasks.title: Add Testing and Validation Framework
tasks.description: Set up automated testing using Jest and Supertest.
tasks.details: Install Jest (v30.x) and Supertest (v8.x). Write unit tests for core logic and integration tests for API endpoints. Aim for at least 90% code coverage. Configure test scripts in package.json.
tasks.testStrategy: Run `npm test` and ensure all tests pass with high coverage. Include tests for edge cases and error handling.

tasks.title: Implement Performance and Scalability Enhancements
tasks.description: Optimize the application for low latency and high concurrency.
tasks.details: Use Node.js cluster module or PM2 for process management to handle concurrent requests. Profile endpoints with autocannon or Artillery. Optimize middleware and avoid blocking operations. Consider caching frequent responses with node-cache.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate 100 concurrent requests using Artillery and verify response times are under 200ms. Monitor CPU and memory usage.

tasks.title: Implement Uptime and Health Monitoring
tasks.description: Add health check endpoints and integrate uptime monitoring.
tasks.details: Create a GET /health endpoint that checks dependencies and returns status. Integrate with an external uptime monitoring service (e.g., UptimeRobot or StatusCake) via webhooks or APIs.
tasks.testStrategy: Manually and automatically ping /health endpoint and verify correct status. Simulate failures and ensure health endpoint reflects system state.

tasks.title: Containerize Application for Deployment
tasks.description: Create a Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml for scalable deployment.
tasks.details: Write a Dockerfile using node:20-alpine as base. Expose necessary ports. Use multi-stage builds for smaller images. Add docker-compose.yml for local development and scaling.
tasks.testStrategy: Build and run the container locally. Verify all endpoints are accessible and environment variables are correctly loaded.

tasks.title: Document API and Development Workflow
tasks.description: Write comprehensive documentation for API usage, setup, and research-backed development workflow.
tasks.details: Use OpenAPI (Swagger) for API documentation. Add a README.md with setup instructions, usage examples, and explanation of research integration. Document testing and deployment steps.
tasks.testStrategy: Review documentation for completeness and clarity. Validate OpenAPI spec with Swagger UI.
